phases.title: Model schemas, validator and golden fixture
phases.desiredOutcome: JSON Schemas for model, issues and theme; validate.mjs rejects dangling ids and missing evidence and checks evidence paths at meta.commit; an anonymised golden model validates.

phases.title: Viewer port, ELK layout and renderer
phases.desiredOutcome: assets/viewer is driven by the model; layout.mjs (vendored elkjs) is deterministic, seeded and honours pins; render.mjs builds clean, internal and shared HTML; the golden render matches the reference in Playwright screenshots of every tab, light and dark, desktop and 400 px, with no console errors.

phases.title: Deterministic pre-scan for the v1 stacks
phases.desiredOutcome: prescan.mjs partitions a repo into at most 8 areas and extracts routes, ORM entities, migrations and client calls for the Python, TS frontend and Node backend stacks, tested on small fixture repos, at 0 tokens.

phases.title: architecture-map skill and agents
phases.desiredOutcome: SKILL.md (500 lines or fewer) and its references define the workflow, model contract, evidence and token rules; archmap-explorer, archmap-synthesizer and archmap-reviewer agents pass claude plugin validate with their model and effort frontmatter.

phases.title: Commands, merge, diffmap and usage ledger
phases.desiredOutcome: build, update, render and export commands run end to end; merge.mjs preserves user-authored fields; diffmap.mjs maps changed files to nodes and their dependents; the usage ledger prints per-phase tokens and duration.

phases.title: Staleness hook, check and issues overlay
phases.desiredOutcome: The SessionStart hook prints one line for a stale model, nothing otherwise, and always exits 0; /archmap:check returns 0 or 1; the reviewer and issues.mjs (with audit import, legacy findings included) write the overlay outside the repo, and the clean render contains no issue text.

phases.title: Exporters
phases.desiredOutcome: export.mjs writes Mermaid flowchart, erDiagram and sequenceDiagram, PlantUML, Markdown and SVG from the golden model, and PNG when headless Chromium is present.

phases.title: Skill evals and trigger description
phases.desiredOutcome: skill-creator evals 1-5 run with and without the skill and are reviewed by the owner; issue recall is at least 60 percent of high and medium reference issues; balanced is cheaper than max; the trigger description is optimised with run_loop.

phases.title: Release v1.0.0 and roadmap
phases.desiredOutcome: Version 1.0.0 tagged in this repo with a changelog entry, the marketplace listing description updated, and docs/roadmap.md covering v1.1 and later.
